description: SvButtonGroup, a segmented button bar for Svelte 5. mode='single' gives radio semantics for a view switcher, mode='multiple' a toggle set for a formatting toolbar, and no mode gives plain actions; a roving tabindex with arrow keys handles focus, and the shared editor contract adds a label, validation and dir for RTL. Items come from an items array and the selection is reported through onChange.

faq.question: What is the difference between single and multiple mode?
faq.answer: single keeps exactly one item pressed and reports its value, like radios; multiple lets any set of items be pressed and reports an array, like bold, italic and underline in a toolbar.

faq.question: How does keyboard navigation work?
faq.answer: Tab enters the group on the pressed or first item, arrow keys move between items and Space or Enter presses one, following the WAI-ARIA toolbar and radiogroup patterns.

faq.question: Can I mix icons and text?
faq.answer: Yes. Each item can carry a label, an icon or both, and the group sizes the buttons consistently.
